question: Can a taking rule using the history of a place, without ranking holder counts, reproduce the made-only first meetings of different descents?
basis: The prior full positive cohort and the earlier two candidate rules informed this choice. Success on the same cases is a new intervention, not a new sample of starts. No growth under these five rules has been run before this freeze.

rules.EVER: Of the offered places, exactly one has ever been taken as an extra in a strictly earlier completed round.
rules.LAST_USE: Among offered places previously taken as extras, take the unique place with the latest round of such a take. If none are marked or the latest round ties, abstain.
rules.NEWEST: Take the sole candidate with the latest round of creation. Every distinction in the start has round zero. A tie abstains.
rules.SOLE_MADE: Take only if precisely one offered place was created after the start.
rules.THREE: Take only if precisely one offered place has exactly three holders before the round. This final comparator reads a fixed holder count and can choose a place with fewer holders than another.

common: Use the very same two-step eligibility and growth as the four preceding rules. All five take a sole eligible candidate regardless of marker; all abstain on an empty offer. Apply selection above only to plural offers. No name tie-breaking. Marks synchronous and updated on completed rounds only. No most-holder selection in any rule.
prediction: At least one rule without any reading of holder multiplicities beyond the base shared-place eligibility makes a wholly made first meeting on a matched positive setting, with no start-held linking distinction. The fixed-three comparator is secondary. Report actual further-reaching takes and strict made-only meetings, and whether a two-step-only take serves that very meeting. Failure of the strict test still permits success on the shared offer or the observed weaker meeting.
population: All 205 original positive start/ration/treatment configurations, their original sorted split rounds, both laws, 7 attempted rounds and the 1500-knot guard. Original interleaved order. Report paired comparable case-by-case results for the previous four selectors and in particular the rings; report exact archive-event matches if extractable.
stopping: All five rules once under both laws and independent counts. Report matched first-meeting counts and at least one reproducing physical case if present. No open-ended search of parameter thresholds. If cost exceeds an hour per program, prerecord and use the leading interleaved prefix. No failure inferred beyond completed stages.
second_program: Implement selection and recompute first meetings with the independent referee engine and compare separately with the producer. Common immutable ordinary-growth base is disclosed. No literal tables are needed for a claim about which physical meetings occur.
